title: First collision velocities
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitudes of velocities after the first elastic collision: v_P1 = (3/5)v_0 and v_Q1 = (2/5)v_0.

title: Height after nth collision
description: Essential: Correctly states the general expression for the height Q rises after the nth collision: h_n = (7/25)^(n-1) * (v_0^2/(25g)).

title: Total height H
description: Essential: Correctly states the total height Q rises from point A: H = v_0^2/(18g).

title: Minimum distance s
description: Essential: Correctly states the minimum distance s between point A and the bumper: s = (8√7 - 13)v_0^2/(200g sinθ).

title: Conservation laws application
description: Important: Applies both conservation of momentum and conservation of kinetic energy correctly for each elastic collision between P and Q.

title: Q's motion with friction
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law or work-energy theorem for block Q's motion, incorporating the given friction (μ_k = tanθ) to find deceleration or energy loss.

title: P's motion without friction
description: Important: Correctly analyzes P's motion under gravity (only) on the incline, including its rebound from the elastic bumper with no energy loss.

title: Pattern recognition for h_n
description: Important: Identifies the geometric progression in the velocities or heights after successive collisions to derive the general term h_n.

title: Condition for no re-collision
description: Important: Sets up the kinematic or timing condition that ensures P does not meet Q before Q stops, leading to the inequality for distance s.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in velocities (e.g., direction along incline) or in the work done by friction/gravity.

title: Friction force mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the frictional force on Q (e.g., uses normal force as 4mg instead of 4mg cosθ) or its work.
